{{Top}}
[[File:ProbeDroid-TSWA.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]]]
{{Quote|An Imperial probe droid.''"<br />"''It's a good bet the Empire knows we're here.|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Probe droids''' (also known as '''probots''' or '''recon droids''') were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were specifically designed and programmed to perform reconnaissance duties. These units were often dispatched by various [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Navy/Legends|navies]] to gather information from a variety of different locations, reporting anything of significance as defined by specific preprogrammed protocols. Some models were equipped with a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]] in order to prevent those whom it had been sent to observe from studying them and determining their source, as well as a small [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-type weapon for defense.

==History==
[[File:Sith_probe_droid.png|thumb|left|150px|A [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|DRK-1 probe droid]].]]
In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], probe [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were used as tools of peaceful exploration, important technological advances that changed the face of deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] understanding. They opened up the way for mapping the unknown reaches of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The first probe droids were developed and produced by [[Galalloy Industries]] to search [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] for valuable resources, such as metals to fuel the processing plants of industry. Probots later helped to expand the Republic's frontiers. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], many probots were employed for military functions by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as exploration had been severely limited by direct Imperial order.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

Prior to the development of probots, remote probes had done the majority of mechanized exploration. These were comparatively simple machines, equipped with onboard [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. However, they were programmed to follow a carefully limited set of parameters and lacked the intelligence for true initiative or understanding.<ref name="GG3" />

The first probe droids were marvels of technological achievement, a single unit capable of doing the work of a team of scientists. Incredible amounts of unexplored territory were thoroughly mapped and charted by these machines during the days of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="GG3" />

[[File:Prowler1000-WSMI.png|thumb|right|180px|A [[Prowler 1000 seeker droid/Legends|Prowler 1000]].]]
Since deep-space exploration was put on hold by the Empire, probe droids were retooled and reprogrammed for search and patrol missions. Many droids were posted along the perimeters of key strategic [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] or [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], serving as automated guardians. Some were remote surveillance droids, observing the amazing array of communication bandwidths and relaying that information to [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau]].<ref name="GG3" />

A great number of probe droids were reprogrammed for deep-space scouting. Their mission, rather than to catalog new worlds, was to uncover unregistered settlements, with a priority on finding bases of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Knowing how quickly Rebels could evacuate upon discovery, many probe droids were equipped with high-frequency [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceivers to immediately relay information. Other added features included advanced scanning equipment, visual and audio monitoring systems, stealth sensor scramblers, a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], and built-in [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]] programming.<ref name="GG3" />

As time went on, probot manufacturers began developing droids specifically for Imperial military applications, most notably [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The resulting probe droids were faster, more lethal and much more efficient at snuffing out Rebels.<ref name="GG3" />
